title: Evaluating Large Language Models with Tests of Spanish as a Foreign Language: Pass or Fail?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs using TELEIA, a multiple-choice benchmark based on Spanish proficiency exams for non-native speakers (PCE, SIELE, and AVE), and analyzing their grammatical and semantic errors to identify negative language transfer (English-centric linguistic bias) resulting from the dominance of English in their training data.
